operatorNotes: Operator scripts lived in the session scratchpad, outside git, adapted from the previous window’s operator scripts; P7 is the committed computePrecommittedWindowPreflight against windowSpecFromAcquisitionWindowStrategy, never reconstructed or forced.

Because the landed adapter does not guarantee replacement-before-primary cross-kind order, every pre-item and post-item check also compared the strategy sha, plan sha, windowPlanHash and the complete ordered list, required the completed observations to be the exact prefix, and required the next item to be the next frozen element.
Draw reserve entries carry no split field, so the replacement is checked against its slot split (draw selection 18, plan and ledger entry: DEV_CONFIRM).

Sealed SD7 detail was written with the landed analyseOrganisation + toSealedRecord under new window-specific filenames with an exclusive-create flag; no existing sealed file was overwritten; after the window every sealed file was rebuilt in memory from the database and byte-compared.
pageAttempts is the orchestrator root summary figure; it counts ROOT, LINK and sitemap-discovered page fetches, which is why SITEMAP observations exceed sitemapDocumentRequests.
R:18:8 robots attempt_no 2 is the landed run-scoped policy attempt counter after a same-registrable-domain host-changing robots continuation, not a transport retry (no retry pair).
P:24 shows a host-changing same-registrable-domain 302 on its root and sitemap requests; ordinary-page redirects are recorded, not followed, and no page evidence resulted. Diagnostic only.

An initial sealed-root comparison with comm over a column-2 sort reported a spurious difference on one pre-existing file; a path-keyed comparison showed 0 changed, 0 removed and exactly the 5 window files added (30 -> 35). The pre-existing file’s birth and modification time are 2026-09-21.
The canonical replacement ledger schema itself carries eche row keys in every entry (landed format, unchanged since genesis); no other file of this window carries institution identity.
